text:
Priya: Quick status for the Rotterdam cutover — hitting the milestone tomorrow 08:00 UTC. Need a couple quick clarifications before we sign off.
Cheng: Thanks. Which routing policy are we shipping for public traffic? is it weighted by region or strict residency?
Priya: Primary policy = residency-first for EU accounts, fallback weighted EU->USW if capacity low. Canary will be 5% global traffic to rotterdam for first 2h.
Alex: KMS question: do we have the customer KMS key available in the NL keyring yet? I saw a ticket but not the ARN.
Maria: DB replicas — I pushed the read-replica PR but haven't run the migration job. Need @Cheng to review network egress rules before I kick migrate. PR: https://git.internal/rw/db/PR-489
Cheng: Looking now. For routing, the policy config we plan to deploy is the one in `infra/routing/rotterdam-policy.yaml`. snippet: ```
policy: residency-first
fallback: weighted
weights:
  eu: 0.8
  usw: 0.2
canary_percentage: 5
```
Sara: Capacity note — Dedicated pool autoscaler needs min_gpus=4 for NL region to hit SLO at 99th. Ops ticket created: OPS-3221.
Priya: Good catch. Also need final confirmation on logging/data residency — logs for EU customers must remain in EU for 30 days per contract. Alex, will the KMS + SIEM export stay inside EU?
Alex: KMS in NL added, key ARN will be posted in a minute. SIEM export: we're toggling the EU-only endpoint flag, config lives in `observability/envs/rotterdam.json`. I'll post exact patch.
infra-bot: smoke-test triggered for rotterdam cluster at 2026-03-15T23:12:10Z — 7/8 checks passed, failing: egress to backup-s3-eu (timeout).
Maria: That egress failure is the migration blocker. Looks like an SG rule missing for backup-s3-eu. Adding rule now, will retest.
Cheng: Ping on review of PR-489 — I left one comment about subnet tags. If you can address, I can approve and we can run the migrate window at 06:00 UTC.
Priya: Can we do migrate + canary ramp starting 06:00, full roll by 10:00 if no regressions? People: @Cheng approve, @Maria run migration, @Alex confirm KMS ARN posted, @Sara monitor autoscaler/metrics.
Alex: ARN posted: arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:111222333:key/abcd-rotterdam-key (this is customer-managed). Confirming SIEM flag toggled to `eu-only`.
Maria: SG rule applied, re-running smoke tests. infra-bot will post results.
infra-bot: smoke-test completed at 2026-03-15T23:28:04Z — 8/8 checks passed.
Sara: I'll be on-call for the 06:00 window and will watch p50/p95/p99 and token throughput. Alert thresholds: p95 > 180ms or error-rate > 0.5% triggers rollback.
Cheng: Approved PR-489 after subnet-tag fix. Ready for migration.
Priya: Perfect. Final checklist: 1) KMS ARN (Alex) ✅ 2) DB PR approved (Cheng/Maria) ✅ 3) Routing policy staged (Cheng) ✅ 4) Autoscaler min_gpus set (Sara) ✅ 5) Smoke tests green (infra-bot) ✅. Rolling timeline set.
Maria: I'll post post-migrate verification steps in the runbook channel and bump the status when done.
Priya: Thanks everyone — reach out if anything unexpected. :thumbsup:
